manifest.title: 电商人吐槽
manifest.description: 广告、退货、活动与平台费：电商运营英语短句

items.text: The ad spend is up; the conversion is on vacation.
items.hint: 广告花费上去了，转化去休假了。

items.text: I optimized the listing and the algorithm ignored me.
items.hint: 我优化了详情页，算法无视了我。

items.text: A one-star review arrived faster than the delivery.
items.hint: 一星评价比物流还快。

items.text: My bestseller is out of stock at the worst time.
items.hint: 爆款在最糟的时候断货了。

items.text: The platform fee found a new way to surprise me.
items.hint: 平台费用又找到新方式惊吓我。

items.text: I replied to the buyer with kindness and a coupon.
items.hint: 我好声好气回了买家，还送了优惠券。

items.text: The return reason was does not match photo, again.
items.hint: 退货原因又是与图片不符。

items.text: My SKU list is longer than my sleep schedule.
items.hint: SKU 列表比我的睡眠更长。

items.text: The promotion calendar is a trap with pretty banners.
items.hint: 大促日历是个带着漂亮 banner 的陷阱。

items.text: I restocked just in time for a policy change.
items.hint: 我补完货，政策就变了。

items.text: The warehouse says shipped; the buyer says where.
items.hint: 仓库说已发货，买家说货呢。

items.text: My ad creative won clicks and lost margins.
items.hint: 素材赢了点击，输了毛利。

items.text: I A/B tested everything except my patience.
items.hint: 我 A/B 测了一切，除了耐心。

items.text: The chargeback came after a five-star honeymoon.
items.hint: 蜜月期五星过后，拒付来了。

items.text: My supplier delayed and my campaign did not wait.
items.hint: 供应商延误了，活动档期不等我。

items.text: I priced to compete and forgot to profit.
items.hint: 我为竞争定了价，忘了盈利。

items.text: The customer wants custom packaging for a low-ticket item.
items.hint: 低客单商品，顾客却要定制包装。

items.text: My inventory is stuck in the wrong fulfillment center.
items.hint: 库存卡在了错误的履约仓。

items.text: I boosted the post and boosted my regrets.
items.hint: 我投流了帖子，也投流了后悔。

items.text: The size chart was clear; the dispute was not.
items.hint: 尺码表很清楚，纠纷不清楚。

items.text: My best traffic day crashed the checkout page.
items.hint: 流量最好的那天，结算页崩了。

items.text: I live for same-day replies and die by midnight tickets.
items.hint: 我为当日回复而活，被午夜工单耗死。

items.text: The influencer deal bought exposure without orders.
items.hint: 达人合作买来了曝光，没有订单。

items.text: My competitor copied the photo and undercut the price.
items.hint: 竞品抄了图还压了价。

items.text: I updated the title for SEO and confused humans.
items.hint: 为了 SEO 改标题，把人搞懵了。

items.text: The holiday surge needs staff I cannot find.
items.hint: 节日高峰需要我找不到的人手。

items.text: My packaging is eco-friendly; shipping damage is not.
items.hint: 包装很环保，运输损坏不环保。

items.text: I scaled ads and scaled the bad creative too.
items.hint: 放量广告的同时，也放量了烂素材。

items.text: The buyer wants a refund and to keep the item.
items.hint: 买家想退款还想留着商品。

items.text: My dashboard is green until I filter by profit.
items.hint: 看板一片绿，直到按利润筛选。

items.text: I negotiated MOQ and still over-ordered.
items.hint: 我谈完起订量，还是订多了。

items.text: The category ban arrived without a useful reason.
items.hint: 类目限制来了，理由却没用。

items.text: My customer service script is nicer than I feel.
items.hint: 客服话术比我真实心情客气。

items.text: I launched a bundle and sold the wrong combination.
items.hint: 我上了套装，卖成了错误组合。

items.text: The tracking number exists in a parallel universe.
items.hint: 物流单号存在于平行宇宙。

items.text: I paid for placement and got a weekend of silence.
items.hint: 我买了资源位，换来一个安静周末。

items.text: My returns pile looks like a second warehouse.
items.hint: 退货堆得像第二个仓库。

items.text: I fixed the PDP and traffic went elsewhere.
items.hint: 我修好了详情页，流量去了别处。

items.text: The voucher ate the margin I planned carefully.
items.hint: 优惠券吃掉了我精打细算的毛利。

items.text: I trust metrics until the attribution model changes.
items.hint: 归因模型一变，我就不信数据了。

items.text: My supplier quality slipped after the second order.
items.hint: 第二单之后，供应商质量就滑了。

items.text: I scheduled posts and forgot the timezone.
items.hint: 我排了内容，却忘了时区。

items.text: The peak season fee arrived with peak season pain.
items.hint: 旺季附加费和旺季痛苦一起来。

items.text: I offered free shipping and paid for it myself.
items.hint: 我提供包邮，自己买单。

items.text: My brand story is strong; the algorithm wants short video.
items.hint: 品牌故事很强，算法只想要短视频。

items.text: I opened a new channel and inherited new problems.
items.hint: 我开了新渠道，继承了新问题。

items.text: The sample looked perfect; the bulk did not.
items.hint: 样品完美，大货不完美。

items.text: I chased ranking and lost the plot on product.
items.hint: 我追排名，丢掉了产品主线。

items.text: My refund policy is clear until a VIP complains.
items.hint: 退款政策一直清晰，直到 VIP 投诉。

items.text: I restocked bestsellers and sat on the slow movers.
items.hint: 我补了爆款，慢销品还在压仓。

items.text: The live stream sold out the wrong colorway.
items.hint: 直播卖掉了错误色号。

items.text: I negotiated CPA and still paid for bots.
items.hint: 我谈了 CPA，还是给机器人付了钱。

items.text: My warehouse overtime invoice arrived before the sales report.
items.hint: 仓库加班账单比销售报告先到。

items.text: I A/B tested price and trained buyers to wait.
items.hint: 我测了价格，把买家训练得会等折扣。

items.text: The platform support ticket is a message in a bottle.
items.hint: 平台工单像漂流瓶。

items.text: I built a brand and still live by search ads.
items.hint: 我做了品牌，却还靠搜索广告活着。

items.text: My COD orders converted well and returned better.
items.hint: 货到付款转化好，退货更好。

items.text: I updated inventory sync and created a double-sell.
items.hint: 库存同步一更新，超卖就来了。

items.text: The creative fatigue hit before my caffeine did.
items.hint: 素材疲劳比咖啡因来得更早。

items.text: End of day, and the orders keep teaching me humility.
items.hint: 一天结束了，订单还在教我谦逊。
